annotations.title: New and closed businesses in Poland (CEIDG)

description: Monthly applications filed in CEIDG, the Polish register of sole proprietorships (Ministry of Development and Technology data on dane.gov.pl): registrations of new sole proprietorships, closures (deregistrations), suspensions and resumptions, registrations minus closures, the latest month against the same month in earlier years, the share of women among founders, sums since January and over 12 months, and the finwire index finwire_new_business_ratio (registration applications per 100 closure applications over 12 months; above 100 the number of firms grows). Counts of applications, not of firms in the register; companies registered in KRS are not included.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.
